package httpapi

func (rt *Router) routes() {
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /guarded", rt.authz(perm, rt.handler))
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /public", rt.handler)
	// A comment that mentions rt.authz( must not make the next line look guarded.
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /commented", rt.handler)
	mux.HandleFunc(
		"GET /multiline",
		rt.handler,
	)
	mux.Handle("GET /via-handle", someHandler)
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /nested", rt.authz(perm, rt.withEngTenant(rt.handler)))
	mux.HandleFunc("GET /platform", rt.authz(perm, rt.requirePlatformAdmin(rt.handler)))
}
